title: ChartDensity-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Numerical Data Reconstruction under Visual Density
abstract: arXiv:2609.38781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising approach for recovering numerical data from scientific charts, but their ability to reconstruct chart data from visually dense figures remains poorly understood. Existing chart understanding benchmarks primarily evaluate question answering or chart-level reasoning and provide limited support for evaluating structured numerical reconstruction from scientific figures. We introduce \textbf{ChartDensity-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on structured numerical data reconstruction from compound chart figures under controlled visual density. Built from charts paired with source-level ground-truth data, ChartDensity-Bench systematically varies the number of simultaneously presented charts ($k\in{1,3,6,9}$), enabling controlled evaluation of density-induced degradation. translated_title: ChartDensity-Bench：面向视觉密度下数值数据重建的多模态大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为从科学图表中恢复数值数据提供了一种有前景的方法，但其从视觉密集图形中重建图表数据的能力仍知之甚少。现有的图表理解基准主要评估问答或图表级推理任务，对评估从科学图形中进行结构化数值重建的支持有限。我们提出了**ChartDensity-Bench**，这是一个用于评估MLLMs在受控视觉密度下从复合图表图形中进行结构化数值数据重建的基准。ChartDensity-Bench基于图表与源级真实数据配对构建，通过系统性地变化同时呈现的图表数量（k∈{1,3,6,9}），实现对密度导致的性能退化的受控评估。我们进一步提出了一个多维度评估框架，涵盖结构可靠性、重建一致性等方面（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出ChartDensity-Bench基准，通过控制同时呈现的图表数量来系统评估多模态大语言模型在视觉密度变化下从科学图表中进行结构化数值数据重建的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChartDensity-Bench, a benchmark that systematically evaluates MLLMs' ability to reconstruct structured numerical data from scientific charts under controlled visual density by varying the number of simultaneously presented charts.
